gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Apple's 140 W fast charge on a 16-inch MacBook Pro needs a USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable (or the 240 W USB-C cable on Nov 2023 and later models), while the 14-inch fast-charges at 96 W, so a 100 W bank is enough for a 14-inch or a MacBook Air.
standout_why: Compared against dupple.com/blog/best-power-bank-2026 (cited), powerbanks.fyi/best/power-banks-under-100 (cited) and powerbanks.fyi/best/25000mah-power-banks. Dupple gives per-port watts, recharge input and a cable-in-box line, but no PD version, no PPS and no device-to-watt or cable pairing. Both powerbanks.fyi pages give mAh, W, Wh, weight and price only. Three cited pages could not be compared: TechRadar AU returned navigation text only, the Best Buy UGREEN page timed out, and us.ugreen.com returned HTTP 429. Scored 2 rather than 3 for that reason, and because UGREEN's in-box cable could not be read.
decides: Confirms the UGREEN 145W 25K ($59.98) as the pick for a 16-inch MacBook Pro, on condition the buyer uses a MagSafe 3 cable (2021 to early-2023 models) or a 240 W USB-C cable (Nov 2023 or later). For a 14-inch MacBook Pro or MacBook Air, the 100 W INIU P63 ($66.99) and Anker 25K ($91.19) already reach Apple's fast-charge wattage, so paying for a 140 W port buys nothing there. The Anker tops out at 100 W per port, below Apple's 140 W combination for the 16-inch. The page still has to settle from UGREEN's own page whether a 240 W cable is in the $59.98 box: Dupple says yes, ChatGPT's first answer said separate cables are needed.

findings.label: What Apple requires to fast charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro (2021 or later)
findings.value: 140W USB-C Power Adapter + USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable; or 140W USB-C Power Adapter + 240W USB-C Charge Cable for MacBook Pro (16-inch, Nov 2023) or later
findings.source_title: Fast charge your MacBook Air or MacBook Pro (Apple Support, published November 05, 2026)
findings.note: Apple lists no USB-C-cable option for 16-inch models before Nov 2023, so on those a 140 W bank reaches 140 W only through Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable plugged into the bank's 140 W port. Apple's wording is about its own adapter; applying it to a 140 W PD 3.1 power bank is our inference.

findings.label: What Apple requires to fast charge a 14-inch MacBook Pro (2021 or later)
findings.value: 96W or 140W USB-C Power Adapter + USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable or USB-C charge cable
findings.source_title: Fast charge your MacBook Air or MacBook Pro (Apple Support, published November 05, 2026)
findings.note: 96 W is under the 100 W single-port output of the INIU P63 and Anker A1695, so a 100 W bank meets Apple's fast-charge wattage for the 14-inch (arithmetic: 96 < 100).

findings.label: What Apple requires to fast charge a MacBook Air (2022 or later)
findings.value: 70W USB-C Power Adapter + USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable or USB-C charge cable; 67W adapter listed for 13.6-inch models only
findings.source_title: Fast charge your MacBook Air or MacBook Pro (Apple Support, published November 05, 2026)
findings.note: Every candidate's main USB-C port (100 W or 140 W) exceeds 70 W.
